crossRefs.note: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence…
I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of…
I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees…
Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and…
The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and…
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is…
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

translations.web: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,
translations.bsb: to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,
translations.kjv: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
translations.asv: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
